scientific_integrity: General theorem is proved using renewal-cycle transforms and a strict diagonal-resolvent inequality; independent replication and independent audit have not been performed. Exact finite experiments are consistency checks only.
scientific_limitations: Exact result applies only to finite irreducible continuous-time Markov row generators and to the endpoint theta-method; the finite threshold is generally an implicit scalar resolvent root. Source date is the directly printed first-online date of the selected 2004 primary paper. No originality claim is made for Runge–Kutta absolute-monotonicity theory, classical Markov regeneration, or the earlier subclass cases.
title: Stationary-mass positivity frontier for the \(\theta\)-method on finite Markov generators
